content:
marie (AE): Quick sync — Orbita POC kickoff. Need to align use cases (chat + summarization + rerank), success criteria, timeline, and integration plan. Can SEs confirm SDK/auth/quota needs? :wave:

devon (SE): Thanks. Main ask: streaming chat (partial tokens delivered), webhook fallback for offline clients, and embeddings for reranking. What's expected throughput so we can size pools?

marie (AE): Customer expects ~100 concurrent users. Typical request ~400 input tokens / ~600 output tokens. Ballpark: 50 RPS steady, 150 RPS peak.

soraya (SRE): For that footprint I'd recommend a Dedicated pool (8x A10G equiv) or Private VPC if they insist on network isolation. Also need to confirm retention requirements for logs.

taylor (sales-engineer): Security question: they want assurance that no PII leaves their tenant and KMS for keys. Are we able to disable request logging per-tenant?

devon (SE): We can offer request redaction and opt-out logging on Dedicated/Private. Auth options: scoped API keys (hosted), signed JWT or mTLS for Private. For a Hosted POC, scoped API key + token scoping is simplest.

samir (PM): Suggested success metrics:
- Quality: baseline vs model F1 on extraction tasks > 0.85
- Latency: p95 end-to-end < 600ms for chat flows
- Cost: average cost per user session < $0.10 (estimate)
- Ops: no more than 3 incidents in POC window

devon (SE): Proposed eval plan: collect 500 representative prompts from their corpus, run A/B vs their baseline, measure precision/recall and hallucination rate, plus manual review for top 50 failing prompts. I can ship a small harness.

devon (SE): SDK snippet for quick streaming prototype (JS):
```js
// minimal streaming example
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const stream = client.chat.stream({ model: 'redwood-1-chat', messages: userMessages });
stream.on('data', chunk => process.stdout.write(chunk.delta || chunk.text));
stream.on('end', () => console.log('done'));
```

soraya (SRE): Retry guidance: client-side exponential backoff with jitter, max 3 retries for 5xx. We will surface 429/503 with Retry-After. For streaming, reconnect semantics should resume from last model token when possible.

devon (SE): Rate-limits / quotas for POC: propose 10k tokens/min quota and a soft limit of 200 RPS sliding window. We'll issue test keys scoped to those quotas.

marie (AE): Pricing question: can ops give a rough POC estimate for 3-week run at the projected usage so I can share with procurement? Also need billing contact for invoicing if they accept.

taylor (sales-engineer): I'll assemble a short estimate (tokens/day -> cost) and include optional Dedicated uplift. cc @samir for pricing approval.

devon (SE): Security questionnaire notes: confirm where logs are stored, retention policy, who can access raw logs, whether customer data is used for model training (we do not use POC data for training by default). I have a template answer set I can paste into their form.

marie (AE): Timeline proposal:
- Week 0: account access, test API keys, basic smoke tests
- Week 1: integration (chat + streaming) + embedding rerank POC
- Week 2: run evaluations on 500 prompts, iterate on prompts/temperature, tune batching/quantization
- Week 3: final demo + decision
Customer is OK with a 3-week runway but asked for early demo end of week 2.

taylor (sales-engineer): Action items (quick):
- (devon) provide eval harness + 500 sample prompts and an example results dashboard
- (soraya) confirm infra recommendation, whether VPC required, and logging opt-out feasibility
- (taylor) draft POC pricing + quota settings and prepare test API key with streaming enabled
- (marie) upload customer security questionnaire and schedule tomorrow 10am PT sync

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: test-keys-create job at 2026-04-02T18:00:00Z for sales/test-poc keys

marie (AE): Thanks — can we do a quick standup tomorrow 10am PT? :calendar:

devon (SE): +1
soraya (SRE): +1
samir (PM): +1
taylor (sales-engineer): +1

marie (AE): Closing note: will_lane on success criteria doc (shared drive) for live edits. If anyone wants to adjust metrics, add inline before the sync. :sparkles:
